column1: AT+CIPSHOWTP Display Transfer Protocol in IP Head When Received Data

column2: Response OK ERROR Parameter <mode> A numeric parameter which indicates whether to display transfer protocol in IP header to received data or not 0 Not display transfer protocol 1 Display transfer protocol, the format is "+IPD, <data size>,<TCP/UDP>:<data>"
Note This command will be effective only in single connection mode (+CIPMUX=0)
